query: Roughly how much net foreign financing, in total and in US dollars, did Colombia have to raise over the five years 2014 to 2018 to fund its external deficits?

text.text: Identifies the balance-of-payments financing identity: a current account deficit must be matched by net external financing (net borrowing from abroad, NLB = CAB + KAB = NFA), so cumulative financing = sum of annual current account balances converted to US dollars.
text.accept: full = BoP financing identity (current account + capital account = net financial account); acceptable alternative: change in net international investment position; no = government financing needs

data.text: Uses WEO current account balance (% GDP) and nominal GDP in US dollars (BCA_NGDPD, NGDPD).

computation.text: Cumulative net external financing Colombia 2014-2018 = US$ 75.1 bn

assembled_from: BPM6 ch.14 (doc 712b0ad9, blocks 3204/3214): "NLB = CAB + KAB = NFA"; "the net provision of resources to or from the rest of the world, as measured by the current and capital account balances, must-by definition-be matched by a change in net claims on the rest of the world." Capital account balance treated as negligible; current account in US$ = BCA_NGDPD x NGDPD.
provenance.selection: seeded draw (seed 3303); five consecutive deficit years, cumulative >= US$5 bn; one per country

gold_report_note: Gold is a printed identity applied to frozen WEO series; no corpus report states these values, nothing to withhold.
published_value_note: no published cumulative; annual BCA and NGDPD are WEO published values
distractors: gross financing needs of the government
balance-of-payments adjustment to terms of trade
